claim_boundary: Retrospective 27-growth method-development outer LOO paired to the inclusive M22 run. Sq/FSMI predictions remain the identical strict outer-LOO M20 head and retain 6022/6101 wherever allowed by each target fold. Only AFM morphology-related fits omit the atypical 6022 and 6101 growths; all 27 growths remain evaluation targets with the same folds and seeds. M22 largest-gap nucleation is target-blind and uses predicted intermediate growth stage. No measured query AFM is used. Selection is retrospective and requires prospective confirmation.

confidence.confidence_definition: Smoothed survival percentile of equal-weight ranks of strictly cross-fitted expected FSMI and island-topology errors. FSMI already contains height amplitude, so Rq is not double-counted.

protocol: retrospective nested leave-one-growth-out over the fixed harmonized 27-growth cohort
